profile.summary: Specialties: Linux, Makefile Systems, SystemC, Boost/STL Libraries, C/C++, Valgrind Memory Validator

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Researched and developed several methods to increase efficiency for training Recommender Systems.
   + Offloading training parameters to SSD with Host/GPU backed cache.
   + Pipelining/prefetching parameters to cache multiple batches ahead of time.
* Pytorch OSS contributions
    + Implemented Microsoft's Zero Infinity, contributed to Fairscale's FSDP.
    + Discovered and Reported errors with simple reproducers for 1.11 __torch_dispatch__ mechanism.
* Hardware Performance Evaluation and Optimization
  + Evaluate prospective vendor products and analyze for training performance. Provide recommendations based on results for Performance and Numerical Accuracy.
  + Investigate and improve performance on "hot" kernels during Recommender Training.
* Mentorship/onboarding new team members:
   + Guidance and support for initial tasks and logical extensions
   + Debugging support for advanced problems.
   + Help unblock infrastructure permissions/access issues associated with new members.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer @Facebook
positions.description:
* Develop experimental features on Facebook's Leading-Edge High Performance Training Cluster
* Research, understand and optimize Deep Neural Network Recommender Systems
* Bring experimental features to 100% Ready state for production integration 
* Created highly performant sparse embedding implementation from scratch using SSDs and hierarchical memory for training 100's to 1000's of TB sized models.
* Extensive experience developing and understanding NVIDIA CUDA kernels, CUDA streams, GPU/Host synchronization, Communication Collectives (e.g. All2All, AllReduce) and optimization.
* Developed custom IO_URING based and RocksDB based backends to optimize IOPS + Latency of SSD read/writes to train large neural networks.
* Extensive Pytorch experience including complex nn.Modules, pybind11 integrations, Torchscript Libraries, DistributedDataParallel

positions.title: AI Applications Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected Wave’s DNN Framework (Tensorflow/Pytorch) integration strategy
* Research, build, and train Deep Neural Nets(DNNs) focusing primarily on vision
* Presented Wave technology to prospective customers and investors
* Created Data Labeling Requirements Specification for 3rd party labeling service
* Configure from scratch local distributed training ecosystem including: hardware selection, automate machine setup and configuration (Ansible), shared file systems (CephFS), Kubernetes, extensive documentation and training deployment examples.
* Multi Object + Multi Camera Tracking – Utilizing Kafka, OpenCV, GStreamer, TensorRT, and python
* Computer Vision – enhanced camera calibration, SLAM systems, Homography, Stereo Rectification, Aruco tags
* Created package to convert ONNX models to Wave’s proprietary model definition

positions.title: Senior AI Software and Simulation Architect
positions.description:
* Architected high level performance simulator for Wave’s custom AI accelerator hardware
.... * Neural Network Execution using custom precision operators and Apache TVM
.... * Simulator trains models to verify convergence using custom precision operators
.... * Python integration via Swig
* Design + Implement + Verify multi-dimensional DMA unit used by hardware
* Helped team gain expertise on AI, types of layers, implementations, and Wave’s HW

positions.title: Graphics Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Software Simulation of Intel Processor Graphics.
* Architected multiple generations of graphics hardware power/performance simulators
* Tech lead for multiple graphics subsystems modeling in simulator
* Cross-team collab in high profile workgroups to develop + optimize next gen features
* Software performance optimization and multithreading
